items.title: Document: agent with rules and standards path, launcher skill with confirmation loop
items.why: The documentation update skill must always start the document agent so documentation-update.md is written.
items.decisions: Launcher passes the absolute path of documentation-standards.md in the brief; keep the sentence a test requires; documentation-create-default and the standards copies stay unchanged; launcher relays Awaiting Confirmation and re-runs with the answer.
items.acceptance: Running /vscode-workflow:documentation-update-default writes documentation-update.md; an Awaiting Confirmation result is shown to the user and re-run with the answer.
items.evidence: Rules merged into agents/document.md, which reads documentation-standards.md from the path in its brief; Skill tool removed. skills/documentation-update-default/SKILL.md is a launcher that passes the path and handles Awaiting Confirmation. documentation-create-default and both standards copies are unchanged; the identical-copies test passes.
items.remaining: Live check pending: run the skill once after re-sync and reload; confirm documentation-update.md appears, and try an Awaiting Confirmation case.

items.title: Code Comments: agent with both modes and two launcher skills
items.why: The comment skills should use the agent like the other three, for isolation.
items.decisions: Keep the no-report contract and the rule never to write under .history/agents/; launchers pass the mode and scope in the brief.
items.acceptance: Both commands start vscode-workflow:code-comments in the right mode and relay its message; no file is written under .history/agents/.
items.evidence: Review and improve criteria inlined into agents/code-comments.md; Skill tool removed; the no-report rule is kept. Both skills are launchers that pass the mode and scope. Plugin content tests pass.
items.remaining: Live check pending: run both commands once after re-sync and reload; confirm no file is written under .history/agents/. A report and accordion for Code Comments is a separate follow-up if wanted.

items.title: Add plugin content tests
items.why: Guard that launchers name their agent and agents no longer load skills.
items.decisions: Check subagent_type in the five launcher skills, no Skill tool in the four agents, the standards sentence in documentation-update-default, and the Document agent reading the standards path from its brief.
items.evidence: Four tests added to test/claudePluginContent.test.ts: launchers name their subagent_type, agents have no Skill tool or skill loading, Document launcher passes the standards path, Code Comments keeps the no-report rule. Full run: 10 files, 112 tests pass.
